data.question: I'm brand new to Obsidian. Is this course suitable?
data.answer: Yes. The course starts with installation and walks through every concept **step-by-step**.

data.question: I already have the Obsidian Starter Kit. Do I need this course?
data.answer: The course complements the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) well. OSK gives you structure and templates; this course shows you how to use them with **2h20** of video.

data.question: Does this course cover the PARA method and Zettelkasten?
data.answer: Yes. Both *PARA* and *Zettelkasten* covered in detail, along with *Johnny Decimal*, *LIFT*, Atomic notes, MoCs, and more.

data.question: How long is the course?
data.answer: **2h20** of video content. Work through at your own pace.

data.question: Can I use this if I don't have Obsidian Starter Kit?
data.answer: Yes. While some examples use the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit), the principles apply to any `Obsidian` setup.

data.question: What version of Obsidian does this cover?
data.answer: The course covers core `Obsidian` features that remain consistent across versions. PKM principles are timeless.

data.question: Will I learn about plugins?
data.answer: Yes. Essential plugins covered: `Templater`, `Dataview`, `Kanban`, `Auto Note Mover`, `Canvas`, and more.

data.question: Is this included in any bundles?
data.answer: Yes. Included with [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community) **Knowledge Master** tier (starting at **€119.99/quarter**) and also in the [Everything Knowledge Bundle](/product/everything-knowledge-bundle).
